name: KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun®
short_description: The KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® is a 21.1km, 10km, and 5km race held on 16 August 2026 at Padang Merbok, Kuala Lumpur.
ai_summary: The KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® is organized by JomRun and will take place on 16 August 2026 in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Runners can choose from 21.1km, 10km, or 5km distances, with the race flagging off at 3:30 AM from Padang Merbok. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining this event.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit different runner levels
Early flag-off time of 3:30 AM helps avoid daytime heat
Central Kuala Lumpur venue at Padang Merbok is accessible
research_highlights: The event offers three distances: 5KM Fun Run, 10KM Fun Run, and 21.1KM (with both Competitive and Non-Competitive/Leisure options).

For the 21.1KM category, only runners registered under '21.1KM SPEED' are eligible for podium prizes, with results based on gun time — those registered as '21.1KM Leisure' are not entitled to podium placement.
Only the 21.1KM finishers receive a race bib with a TrackAsia RFID timing chip and an exclusive finisher jersey; 5KM and 10KM runners get a bib without a timing chip.
In the previous KL Half Marathon (2025) edition, race kit collection was held at Decathlon @ NU Sentral over two days before the event.
As of the most recent listing, the exact date, time, and venue for the 2026 edition were still marked 'To Be Confirmed' by the organizer.

faqs.question: When is the KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® taking place?
faqs.answer: The KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® is scheduled for 16 August 2026. The event will be held in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with the race flagging off early in the morning at 3:30 AM from Padang Merbok, according to the organizer JomRun.

faqs.question: What distance options are available for this race?
faqs.answer: Participants in the KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® can choose from three distance categories: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km run, and a 5km run. This range of options allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open for the KL Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® is currently open. Interested runners looking to secure a spot in the 21.1km, 10km, or 5km categories can register now ahead of the race day on 16 August 2026 in Kuala Lumpur.

faqs.question: Where does the KL Half Marathon 2026 start?
faqs.answer: The race starts at Padang Merbok in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with a flag-off time of 3:30 AM. This central venue serves as the starting point for all three distance categories offered at the KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun®.
